# git.agentic

> Open-source infrastructure for software written and run by AI agents.

git.agentic is an open-source suite written by Toni Bergholm. It has three
projects. A git.agentic commit versions the six dimensions that determine AI
agent behavior (code, prompts, tools, model, memory, and schema). Rollback
restores prompts, tracked memory and schema directly, and records the code,
tools and model that the operator must redeploy. src-control is version control for parallel in-memory agent
worktrees, with encrypted collaboration, Git interoperability, a self-hosted
Git forge (sc-forge), and a native desktop repository browser. Sentinel is
agent-auditable npm supply-chain security.

## Products

- [git.agentic](https://git-agentic.com/git-agentic): Version control and rollback for AI agent behavior. Rollback restores prompts, memory and schema and records the code, tools and model to redeploy. Status: MVP complete, validation in progress. Not in production use yet.
- [src-control](https://git-agentic.com/src-control): Version control and a Git forge for fleets of AI agents, with in-memory worktrees, encrypted paths and branches, signed provenance, Git sync, and a native read-only desktop browser. Status: pre-1.0, in production use for sc-forge only, as the project Git host at Codento Engine. The cryptography has had no independent audit.
- [Sentinel](https://git-agentic.com/sentinel): An auditing security layer and registry for npm used by agents. Status: pre-1.0 alpha (0.1.0-alpha.2 on npm), in production use at Codento Engine as an auditing npm proxy in observe mode. It scores every tarball and blocks none yet. APIs may change.

All three projects are open source under Apache 2.0. Neither src-control nor
Sentinel has production users outside Codento Engine. Status and limits are
stated on each product page. Contact: toni@git-agentic.com.
